description: This Java source file defines the OrderSetMember class within the OpenMRS project. The class models a member of an order set, including attributes like order type, concept, and associated order set, and provides getter and setter methods for these fields.

classes.name: OrderSetMember
classes.description: Represents a member of an order set with attributes for order type, concept, associated order set, and template details, extending BaseChangeableOpenmrsMetadata.

methods.name: getOrderSetMemberId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the order set member.

methods.name: setOrderSetMemberId
methods.description: Sets the identifier for the order set member.

methods.name: getOrderType
methods.description: Retrieves the type of the order.

methods.name: setOrderType
methods.description: Sets the type of the order.

methods.name: getOrderTemplateType
methods.description: Retrieves the type of the order template.

methods.name: setOrderTemplateType
methods.description: Sets the type of the order template.

methods.name: setConcept
methods.description: Associates a Concept with the order set member.

methods.name: getOrderSet
methods.description: Retrieves the OrderSet associated with the member.

methods.name: setOrderSet
methods.description: Associates an OrderSet with this member.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique ID of the order set member (overrides parent method).

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique ID of the order set member (overrides parent method).
